versions.changelog:
azure-networking-audit v0.1.1

- Added new reference documents: CLI command reference and VNet architecture model.
- Updated skill metadata to include OpenClaw-specific fields.
- No changes to overall skill description or audit procedure.

Initial release of Azure VNet Networking Audit skill.

- Audits Azure Virtual Network (VNet) design, NSG rules, Azure Firewall policies, ExpressRoute/VPN connectivity, VNet peering, and route tables using read-only Azure CLI.
- Stepwise procedure: VNet inventory, NSG audit, Firewall/policy review, connectivity checks, peering/topology, and route/UDR validation.
- Focused on security posture, compliance, connectivity troubleshooting, and cost optimization.
- Requires Azure CLI access, Reader RBAC, and Network Watcher enabled for full functionality.
- Explicitly excludes application-layer and DNS management; covers VNet-layer Azure networking only.
